reason: The method materially changed from sampling an unmatched HM Land Registry-derived title-boundary polygon to an Ordnance Survey policy/semantics check on whether OS large-scale topography can serve as canonical parcel geometry. OS explicitly states that OS MasterMap Topography Layer shows physical features at survey time and never legal property boundaries or ownership, and that OS itself does not publish a property-extents dataset under OGL because doing so could be mistaken for authoritative legal extent. Therefore OS topographic polygons cannot be substituted for a canonical parcel/title polygon. The verified lineage still lacks a target-bound authoritative parcel geometry for BUILDING_PRESENT; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
